Danger Zone

Restore to factory settings

Erase all configured devices, learned IR devices, activities, macros, custom icons and settings, then return OpenRemote to an empty factory state.

SD
Format SD Card

Erase the SD card?

Formatting permanently removes every file stored on the remote's SD card, including themes, custom icons, device data, the IR database and backups.

This action cannot be undone. Remove or separately copy anything you want to keep before continuing.
!
Permanent Reset

Erase user configuration

Devices, activities, macros, custom icons, custom themes, settings and saved Wi-Fi will be removed. The SD card is not formatted; WebConfig, firmware, backups and Default libraries stay intact.

This action cannot be undone. Create a complete backup first if you may need this configuration again.

Add Device Wizard

Choose a connection method

OpenRemote can combine traditional IR equipment with modern Bluetooth and local-network devices.

ᛒ
Bluetooth HID remote

The ESP32-S3 will appear as a keyboard/media remote. Pairing happens from the streamer’s Remotes & Accessories menu after syncing.

Directional navigationOK / SelectHome & BackPlayback controlsVolume media keys
Voice microphones and proprietary assistant buttons are not included. TV or receiver power can still be handled by a separate IR device and OpenRemote’s power memory.

Apple TV via IR Learn Remote

OpenRemote creates a dedicated navigation profile. After syncing, use Apple TV Settings → Remotes and Devices → Learn Remote and teach each command.

Up / Down / Left / RightSelectMenu / BackPlay / PauseStop
This avoids relying on Apple’s proprietary Siri Remote Bluetooth protocol. Siri voice, touch gestures and microphone functions are not included.
⌂
Homebridge local connection

OpenRemote signs in through your ESP32, discovers real writable accessories and executes their commands directly on the local network.

Not connected. Credentials are sent only to your OpenRemote and stored in its NVS, never in index.html or runtime.json.
Homebridge must have accessory control enabled and run with insecure mode enabled. Read-only sensors are omitted because they cannot be controlled by a remote.
